rv.q: You’ll also leave this truly marvelous experience with both an inquisitive mind and a stronger sense of self.
This is an unforgettable experience that gives you plenty to unpack afterward, and it works well with friends or family, since you’ll move through it in small groups.

Among the many subtly brilliant feats Theater of the Mind accomplishes is the ability to time travel and return to periods in David’s childhood that take on a completely different tenor from the vantage point of maturity.
Theater of the Mind isn’t just theater, it’s truly a theatrical revelation best described as deeply imaginative human exploration.

cn.t: Critics rave about Theater of the Mind's bold fusion of neuroscience and immersive theater, praising its sensory journey through memory and perception. David Byrne and Mala Gaonkar's collaboration earns near-universal acclaim as a genuinely unique theatrical experience.
